title: Phone-width controls and a refused form's accessibility
assertion: At 390 px an input, a select and a text area are at least 16 px; at 1280 px they are 14 px; a refused form passes axe (WCAG 2.1 A and AA) at both widths
noFileReason: The public request form and a synthetic practice’s form are measured and scanned in the browser; no file.
